vlm_extraction_hints: Classify page archetype dynamically: Cover, Table_of_Contents (Highlights, Fashion News, Cover Looks), Feature_Pictorial (fashion editorial well), Stockist_Directory ('Where to Buy'), Advertisement (luxury fashion, cosmetics, fragrances), Editorial_Masthead, or Back_Cover.

Identify overlapping visual attributes shared across periodicals: model/celebrity subject, body pose (Standing, Reclining, Sitting, Close_Up), scene environment (studio backdrop, interior, outdoor architectural), lighting, and color palette.

Extract garments, cuts, materials, and accessories (e.g. trench coat, gown, blazer, scarf, clutch, jewellery, lingerie, pumps) along with designer brands (Givenchy, Chanel, Dior, Saint Laurent, Gucci, Fendi) and prices from captions or shopping directories.
Identify creative credits: photographer, fashion editor/stylist, hair stylist, and makeup artist.
